title: Ten Regions
author: cornish-john
rules:
Click on the puzzle image or the link below to play

Rules:

Sudoku: Each row, column, and region must contain the digits 1-9 once each.

Anti-Knight: Cells separated by a knight's move in chess cannot contain the same digit.

Region Sum Lines: Segments in each region along a blue Region Sum Line must sum to the same total. Different lines may have different totals.

Ten Sum Lines: Each grey Sum Line divides into one or more contiguous groups of cells that each sum to 10. Every cell on the line belongs to exactly one group, and groups may not overlap.

Solve here
solutionCode: Digits in row 5 from left to right.
